notes.title: Giant Throne and Liberty update unleashes its impressive new player housing
notes.notes:
The Throne and Liberty Solisium's Awakening update is here, and it feels almost like a fresh starting point for the vast world built by Amazon Games and NCSoft. This starts with a comprehensive and immersive new player housing system that looks set to rival the likes of Final Fantasy 14 and World of Warcraft, but it runs much deeper. On the battle side, there's another support weapon, improved progression and the option for a 'hyperboost' feature to catch up to where you want to be, more endgame build options, better beginner assistance, and the addition of the most highly requested PvP mode. Whatever you're after, Throne and Liberty 3.0 is looking to deliver.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update 2.16.0
notes.notes: [p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.16.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 25 and last approximately 5.5 hours. It includes the first 12-player Raid, Ascended Arch Bosses, and more. Find the full list of changes below.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="suODKOk1aOA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Altar of Calanthia: 12-Player Raid[/h2][p]Vanquish Calanthia before her dream becomes a nightmare for all of Solisium. Fearsome bosses will attempt to stop you on your way to the altar. Upon your arrival, you’ll face the Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion.[/p][list][*][p]Complete the Two Wings of Sylvaeth Codex part I and II to enter Altar of Calanthia. Entry portals and related crafting NPCs can be found in the north end of Herba Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Party Matchmaking and Party Board listings for the Altar of Calanthia can be accessed through the Raid UI at the entry portal. The standard Party Matchmaking UI will not show the raid. Matchmaking can only be used to enter Normal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]The Raid matchmaking system will form two parties consisting of one tank, one healer, and four DPS roles. Pre-formed Vanguards do not have role restrictions on party formation. Teams can structure their Raid group as they prefer.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal mode requires players to be at least 5,000 Combat Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficult mode requires players to be at least 6,000 Combat Power. Difficult mode has increased boss stats, mechanics, and phases.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can complete and receive rewards from both Normal and Difficult mode each week.[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints: Defeating a boss in Altar of Calanthia counts as a checkpoint. Groups will be able to re-enter and pick up from checkpoints at a later time within the week. Players are not locked to specific group progress and can join multiple groups in a week. Defeating previous bosses again will not offer additional rewards until the week resets.[/p][/*][*][p]When a team is fully defeated on any boss in Normal Mode, all players will receive a damage and HP buffs for additional attempts. This buff stacks up to 10 times and can only be applied once every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards: Each week, killing Calanthia on any difficulty guarantees a Heroic Armor or Weapon. Difficult mode offers higher chances for Weapon drops or Selection Chests instead of random drops. Heroic Accessories will be available alongside an even more difficult version of the Raid in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Altar of Calanthia introduces two new materials: Entropy Shards and Chaos Prisms. These materials are used to make Heroic enhancement materials, Heroic Skill Core management items, and Heroic gear.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Solisium Style Pack[/h3][p]Transform your look with our biggest style update yet when the Solisium Style Pack comes to the Shop on June 26! Discover new hairstyles, hats, helmets, plus Dye and Sewing Thread to further personalize your favorite outfit.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4Yj5SXvt97fhIM75eh1Q11/90161516e1b1499bd23079751bc2007b/TL_Solisium_Style_Pack_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019407.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Solisium Style Pack includes:[/p][list][*][p]30x Illusion Scroll[/p][/*][*][p]100x Dye[/p][/*][*][p]40x Sewing Thread[/p][/*][*][p]Hairstyles: Polished, Free Spirit[/p][/*][*][p]Hats: Leather Bush Hat, Admiral’s Bicorne[/p][/*][*][p]Helmets: Crested Centurion, Basic Bruiser[/p][/*][/list][h3]Heroic Gear[/h3][list][*][p]The Altar of Calanthia raid introduces a new grade of equipment drops: Heroic grade.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters may only equip one Weapon and one Armor of Heroic grade at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic grade is a higher grade than existing Epic gear. A base powered Heroic item is equivalent to a max enhanced Tier 2 Epic item.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic items have primary and secondary stats as well as three slots for traits, similar to other gear grades. They also have a Heroic Trait that enhances one of the 5 base stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic Weapons do not come with passive skills. Instead, you can extract the passive skill as a Skill Core from any Tier 1 Arch Boss Weapon or any Epic Tier 2 weapon and apply it to your Heroic weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Craft Skill Core items at the Skill Core NPC near the Altar of Calanthia Raid portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic gear is leveled using the new craftable Heroic Growthstones as materials.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ascended Arch Bosses: Queen Bellandir and Tevent[/h3][list][*][p]New upgraded difficulty versions of arch bosses Tevent and Queen Bellandir are now on the weekly schedule:[/p][list][*][p]Ascended Arch Bosses take place at 4:00pm local server time on Tuesdays and Saturdays. The regular Queen Bellandir previously scheduled on Saturdays will now take place on Friday.[/p][/*][*][p]These new Arch Boss versions drop materials used to upgrade your existing Arch Boss weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 2 versions of the Tevent and Bellandir Arch Boss Weapons can now be crafted at any Weapon Crafter.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting a Tier 2 Arch Boss weapon requires a Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon of the same type as crafting material.[/p][/*][*][p]For the consumed Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon, all traits will be reset and do not carry over to the Tier 2 weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 2 Arch Boss weapons have an enhanced weapon skill compared to their Tier 1 counterparts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Arena Season 2[/h3][list][*][p]Arena Season 2 will end at the start of maintenance.[/p][/*][*][p]A month-long 6v6 Arena event season will begin after maintenance completes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Markers: Ground markers can now be placed in the world to indicate tactical locations for your party.[/p][list][*][p]By default, the Party Leader has access to place ground markers, but permissions may be managed through the Party UI.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Observer Mode expansion: Observer Mode can now be activated on PvE content such as Raids, Guild Raids, Dimensional Trials, and more. Manage Observer mode settings through the Party Management UI.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Item Quickslots have been expanded from 4 slots to 8 slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Mastery: Tooltips for Weapon Mastery nodes now show the current stat benefit applied from the node, the value gained by the next level, and the value gained at max level.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Tax Delivery and Castle Siege now take place back-to-back on the same day instead of split across 2 weeks. The alternate week is now scheduled for Interserver Siege battles. These 2 events will cycle on a biweekly schedule.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing spawn protection provided when spawning during Sieges.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat: A variety of pre-set chat messages have been added that can be assigned to the ring menu for quick selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat: Message triggers may now be set to send pre-written chat messages based on activity triggers, like logins or party joins.[/p][/*][*][p]Riftstones and Boonstones: Increased the stat bonuses provided by Riftstone and Boonstone owner buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]Riftstones and Boonstones: Decreased the preparation timer at the start of Riftstone and Boonstone battles from 5 to 2 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Adjusted the portal location for the boss portal in Seal Sanctuary to be further south.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Grimturg: Adjusted some cases where Grimturg unexpectedly moved during mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Urstella Fields: Adjusted mob density in some areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeons: 3 and 4-Star Dungeon reward chests may now be opened two times per run.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: The corruption debuff from Exodus will now be removed upon moving to a safe zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Contracts: Fixed an issue where interactable bottles in Talandre for the 'Collect Letters in a Bottle' contracts were only visible while within 5m of range.[/p][/*][*][p]Food: The buff granted by Enticing Cream Pudding now matches its description.[/p][/*][*][p]War Games: Players on different teams can no longer form a party together.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting: Fixed an issue where the quantity button was inactive when supplementing materials from a selection chest during crafting.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure Codex: Chapter 4: Fixed a case where the Rescue Operation codex could sometimes not be progressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Fixed a case where players could swap weapon types without incurring an intended ability cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Longbow[/h3][list][*][p]Flash Arrow: Increased area of effect by 2 meters. Now always attempts to hit, but the effect can be resisted by the target. On hit, applies a ranged evasion debuff to the target. Cooldown reduced from 60 seconds to 36 seconds, damage increased from 150% to 250%.[/p][/*][*][p]Brutal Arrow: Now increases damage by 40% against stunned or bound targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Mastery: Rhythmical Shooting: General weapon damage increases by 3~12 for 3 seconds each time you use different skills in sequence. Stacks up to 5 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Healing Touch: Added a fourth specialization that changes Healing Touch to a self-buff, adds a damage bonus when using longbow skills, but also reduces your movement speed for 4 seconds while active.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spear[/h3][list][*][p]Phoenix Barrage: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 91% of Base Damage +23, to 73% of Base Damage +19. Damage boost against monsters increased from 125% to 180%.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Fury: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 360% of Base Damage +100, to 288% of Base Damage +80. Damage boost against monsters increased from 40% to 75%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dagger[/h3][list][*][p]Thundering Bomb: Reduced base damage. Reduced damage bonuses applied when striking from the back or when target is under Weaken effects. Damage boost against monsters increased from 15% to 40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadowy Escape: Fixed an issue where players would rarely teleport back to their casting point upon teleporting with Shadowy Escape.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Greatsword[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing Death Blow and Guillotine Blade to be canceled if used a 2nd time while it's being charged.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Staff[/h3][list][*][p]Burning Smokescreen: Added a short cooldown before a 2nd Burning Smokescreen can be used to prevent it from accidentally being cast twice.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Amitoi and Morphs: Tooltips on Amitoi and Morph icons now tell you if you've acquired that Amitoi or Morph.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Added the ability for controller shortcuts to be assigned to main menus such as Inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking: Changing zones or closing a menu no longer closes the 'Matchmaking Successful' popup resulting in it being declined.[/p][/*][*][p]Trials: Fixed an issue causing Trial-specific Dungeon UI elements to rarely not be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Codex: Fixed an issue causing the camera to occasionally get stuck when attempting to teleport to the Amitoi house while the camera pans during a cinematic scene.[/p][/*][*][p]PlayStation 5: The sun now appears without a black object in front of it.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.14.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1AngRHW9BfbAsrsNaPF0Ef/3026e6932de5bda4d3a39f5d7b119b17/TL_Swamp-of-Silence_02_Final_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.14.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 11 and last approximately 6.5 hours. It includes the Archboss Guild Raid event, Road to Raid activities, and special login rewards. Find the full list of changes below.

[h2]Road to Raid[/h2]
[url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/road-to-raid-event]Road to Raid[/url] continues with additional rewards for Dimensional Trials as well as Dynamic Event player kills and assists (PvP). Whether you return to Nebula Island, Dimensional Trials, or look for new guild members, crafting with Abyss Contract Tokens will further improve your gear before your destined showdown against Calanthia on June 26.

Claim special login rewards to finish your Raid preparations during Storm's Eve from June 19 through 26.

[list]
[*] Day 1: 5x Random Chaos Rune Chests
[*] Day 2: 30x Rare Artifact Chance Chests
[*] Day 3: 50x Precious Rune Chance Chests
[*] Day 4: 4x Nebula Conquest Chests
[*] Day 5: 25x Adventure Coin: Loyalty
[*] Day 6: 10x Trait Resonance Stone
[*]  Day 7: 7x Chaos Soul Shard: Calanthia
[/list]
Milestone 10, "Vengeance Ascendant," leads up to the Raid, opening with in-game milestones to take part in.

[h3]Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2ldsN68Qy2mgmOlHnjJ7bS/6bc4643ff6eae59826d0fe4adfd9dcae/T_L_Launch_Team_Update_Screens_Tevent_v01_B_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Between June 12 and June 25, guilds will have access to a special version of the Tevent fight as a Guild Raid.
[*] The Guild Raid version of Tevent has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
[*] Guilds may enter the Tevent guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
[*] Defeating the Guild Raid version of Tevent will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
[/list]
[h3]Arena Season 2 Ending[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2AX7uOA3QNkt2rqsxecXc7/6f39e229b3d25fc4e58979769f39fdbe/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_Arenas_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
Arena Season 2 officially comes to a close on June 26th.

[h3]Crafting: Precious Recovery Crystals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Four new kinds of high-tier Recovery Crystals are now available for crafting via the Cooking skill.
[*] Recipes to craft these new Recovery Crystals can be purchased from the Contract Coin Merchant for 3,000 Contract Coins each.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.12.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3Mc1DCfYy7t8mKtqeKwLBy/2a9ef0fcc46078432b88d15846ebbb25/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_03_Final_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.12.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 28 and last approximately 5 hours. Descend into the depths of a new 4-Star Co-Op Dungeon, gain more power with new Earring equipment, and experience new events on your Road to Raid. We also have a new episode of Tico Talks covering the latest updates.

Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.

[h2]Tico Talks[/h2]
[previewyoutube=g88JpOz5bU0;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome back to Tico Talks, featuring THRONE AND LIBERTY Globalization Design Manager, Tico. This episode covers Raid gear, PvP meta changes, Dimensional Trials, Nebula Island, and Interserver Castle Siege. What do you think is going to be the meta for beating the raid? Let us know your answer to this episode's community question in the comments section of our YouTube video or on [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]​4-Star Co-Op Dungeon: Crypt of Augmentation[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2MKziWC3kNjIc5oKw3u4sW/fe935b5ef918767d1602552a77fffcda/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_01_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019299.jpg[/img]
Confront the necromancer Velentra in the Crypt of Augmentation for substantial rewards, including essential Tier 2 equipment drops, that will accelerate your gear progression. Once a professor of light magic at Venelux, Velentra's life changed forever when she witnessed the extraordinary powers of the Arkeum knight Calanthia. Now transformed by dark magic, this mysterious necromancer stands before us, commanding ancient powers in devoted service to her dark mistress.

The Crypt of Augmentation will require a Combat Power of 5000 to enter. Master it for an easier time against Calanthia no matter how badly she wants your Star Fragment.

[h3]Earrings - New Equipment Slot[/h3]
A new accessory equipment slot has been added: Earrings!
[list]
[*] The Earring slot is available automatically to all characters after the 2.12.0 update.
[*] Earrings can be acquired through various content such as Tier 2 tokens at the All Things Merchant, Nebula Island, Co-Op and Solo Dungeons, and Talandre Arch Bosses.
[/list]
[h3]Combat Update - Positional Attacks[/h3]
[list]
[*] The combat system now recognizes when an attack comes from front, rear, or flanking directions.
[*] Multiple abilities have been updated with positional damage or effects based on attacking from the flank or rear of the target, so take a moment to review your skills for potential benefits!
[/list]
[h3]Interserver Siege[/h3]
[list]
[*] Castle-owning Alliances can now take part in an Interserver Siege event every 3 weeks, pitting castle owners on different servers against each other in Siege combat.
[*] Alliances will be paired up and both sides will have an opportunity to attack and defend.
[*] A portion of tax revenue from each participating server will be added to the reward pool, and divided among the participating alliances based on the outcome of the battle.
[*] Emerging victorious will reward participants with a temporary title, temporary cloak cosmetic, chaos runes, and consumables.
[*] Victorious alliances will also bring a 48-hour server wide buff to their home server, granting all players on that server increased Abyss Point efficiency and combat damage bonus.
[*] The less-victorious Alliance members will receive a selection of consumables and chaos runes for their efforts.
[*] The first Interserver Siege is slated to take place June 15, with eligible participants based on the outcome of the regular Sieges on June 1.
[/list]
[h3]Mystic Globe Sollant Event[/h3]
Mystic Globes and Mystic Portals have inexplicably been swapped for Lucky Bags. Gather Lucky Bags around Solisium from May 29 until maintenance on June 11 for additional rewards and Sollant items.

[h3]Fortune’s Calling Event[/h3]
Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 11. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions for a chance to net extra rewards like the Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest.

[h3]Color Craft: Amitoi Edition Winner[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1RgJdrPhgx3NrhHWKlU3XJ/b6f4880302c77cfa80a1123a8420bdd1/TL_Amitoi_Coloring_Contest_Final_1920x1080_CT-000018962__1_.jpg[/img]
We asked you to color in Growling Wolfie Amitoi images with your own personal touch as part of the Color Craft: Amitoi Edition Discord event. Following the final community vote, we’re excited to announce the winner in [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Discord[/url]. Their Amitoi will be added to the game as a future reward.

[h3]New Codex Entries[/h3]
New Adventure and Extra Codex entries have been added with additional story quests and rewards.
[list]
[*] Interlude: The Order of the Swan and Extra: Two Wings of Sylvaeth introduce story related to the upcoming raid release.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collection Codex: Added the Miscellaneous Collection Codex with additional collections to complete and new rewards, including materials and profile frames.
[*] Morphs: Increased the level cap for Dash, Glide, and Swim Morph levels and bonuses!
[*] Nebula Island: Combined basic and greater Nebula Stone merchants into a single shop merchant.
[*] Field Boss: Players will no longer be pulled into a Dominion event after leaving the party that signed up for it.
[*] Events: Festival of Fire: Fixed a rare issue causing Phase 2 to not complete after extinguishing all fires around a Chief Priest's Brazier.
[*] Cooking: Enticing Cream Pudding: Changed the bonus Wildkin damage and resistance effect to bonus Construct damage and resistance effect.
[*] Cooking: Added more types of Cooking contracts to the Contract NPCs in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre. This should also fix cases where players ran into empty Cooking contract lists when pursuing them.
[*] PvP: Removed the setting for 'Always Use Amitoi Recovery in PvP Combat' which did not actually use recovery items.
[*] Siege: Slightly increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing applied when respawning during Siege or Tax Delivery events.
[*] Crimson Manor: Fixed an area where players could get stuck if landing from a glide near Snowburn Summit.
[*] Cosmetics: Fixed various rendering issues with the Casual Chic outfit.
[*] PlayStation-Only Servers: New characters created on PlayStation-Only servers will once again receive a complimentary server transfer ticket.
[*] Controller: Fixed a rare issue causing UI navigation to continue even after the joystick was released.
[*] Console: Xbox Series S: Fixed an issue causing NPC's to occasionally T-pose upon log in.
[*] Voice Chat: Fixed an issue causing voice chat to deactivate when entering/exiting instances.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party Matchmaking: Added the ability to sort the list of available dungeons and Dimensional Trials in ascending or descending difficulty.
[*] Targeting: Added icons to Boss NPCs to indicate their Boss status.
[*] Guild: Adjusted the layout of the Guild UI to reduce the size of the Friendly Guild list and display more Guild Notices.
[*] HUD: Weather info will no longer be hidden after collapsing then expanding the minimap.
[*] HUD: Icons on the minimap are now displayed correctly when the minimap size is expanded beyond the default setting.
[*] Minimap: Fixed an issue where icons for former party members could remain visible on the minimap.
[*] Minimap: Added options to allow or prevent click interactions on the minimap.
[*] Settings: Added options to allow rotating character in place through mouse drag.
[*] Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of visual effects.
[*] Settings: Fixed an issue preventing some HUD UI sizes from being selectable in the Settings menu.
[*] Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of floating damage numbers.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats: Added new bonus effects for reaching stat values of 80 or more.
[*] Items: You can now receive buff effects from both attack and defensive food at the same time.
[*] Akman's Bloodletting Crossbow: Akman's Fragment effect will now only trigger when the Selfless Diffusion skill is active.
[/list]
[h3]Crossbow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wild Barrage: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be displayed in some locations when the Wild Barrage specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
[*] Nimble Leap: Whirlpool Specialization: Movement speed increase within the Whirlpool area reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*] Wind Snatcher: Maximum movement speed bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.
[*] Mastery: Agile Strike: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 3% to 2%.
[*] Mastery: Mirage Dancer: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 10% to 8%.
[/list]
[h3]Dagger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camouflage Cloak: Duration reduced by 3 seconds. Slightly reduced the duration extension provided through specialization.
[/list]
[h3]Greatsword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Reckless Assault: Fixed an issue where Reckless Assault was not applying the additional 50% boost to Raging Frenzy.
[*] Blood Devotion: After being affected by Blood Devotion, players will now be unable to receive the affects of Blood Devotion again for 45 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Longbow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Healing Touch: The amount of healing provided has been reduced by 16%.
[*] Blitz: Can no longer reset the cooldown on Wand's Fountain of Life.
[/list]
[h3]Spear[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rupture: Fixed an issue where Rupture ignored Weaken Resistance.
[*] Predator: Added a function to Predator that removes stacking recovery effects applied by player skills in the order they were most recently applied, one stack at a time.
[/list]
[h3]Sword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Provoking Roar: This ability now forces the user to the top of the target's aggro list for 6 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Wand[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blessed Barrier: Fixed an issue causing the player's Buff Duration Bonus to not apply to the secondary buff applied by Blessed Barrier.
[*] Swift Healing: Mana cost of tier 2 and 3 Swift Healing has been reduced to match the cost of Tier 1, however the amount healed by tier 2 and 3 is also reduced.
[/list]
[h3]War Games[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spectator Mode: Additional features added to Spectator Mode including quick-swap saves for following specific characters, UI improvements to reduce on-screen clutter, and camera rotation sensitivity settings.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck underground when entering a War Games match as a Spectator while dead.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Spectators to occasionally swap from Tracking Mode to Free Roam Mode without input.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck when navigating to specific areas.
[*] Portals and Pitons can no longer be targeted while in Spectator mode.
[*] The Camera Speed setting now affects the camera's zoom in/out speed as well.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.10.0
notes.notes:
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.10.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 14 and last approximately 3 hours. Queen Bellandir has been defeated countless times, but they’re ready for revenge from May 15 through May 29. Conquer new mechanics and discover altered loot tables as you take on a trickier variant of this familiar foe. Bonus weapon mastery points and expedited fishing progression will also be available from May 15 through May 22.

Find the full list of changes below.

[h3]Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Between May 15 and May 29, guilds will have access to a special version of the Queen Bellandir fight as a Guild Raid.
[*] The Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
[*] Guilds may enter the Queen Bellandir guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
[*] Defeating the Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
[/list]
[h3]Fishing Bonuses: Special Bait Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pick up special Fishing Bait from event NPCs in Kastleton, Vienta Village, and Herba Village between May 15 and May 22 and get to your nearest shoreline to put it to use!
[*] Anglers of all levels can benefit from this bait, as it can catch special fish that provide bonus Fishing experience as well as additional items when reeled in.
[/list]
[h3]War Games - Spectator Mode[/h3]
This update adds Spectator Mode cameras that allow anyone to watch the action during a War Games match.
[list]
[*] Browse the list of upcoming War Games and join public matches as a Spectator. Match owners retain control over whether matches are public or private, and the access of individual participants including spectators.
[*] Both Free Camera and Target Follow Camera options are available in Spectator Mode.
[*] Free Camera allows you to fly around the match space to view any part of the action that most interests you, or set up to view critical map points.
[*] You can also save specific camera angles to function keys and quickly swap between them later.
[*] Follow Camera lets you select the player you wish to follow from the list of active players in the match to lock the camera to their movement.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] After reviewing player feedback and gameplay data, equipment drop rates will be slightly increased across a variety of content, with an emphasis on increased accessibility of Tier 2 equipment.
[*] Boss-type content: Guild Raids, Field Bosses
[*] Dungeon content: 3-Star Dungeons, Hall of Illusion
[*] Open-world Content: Abyss Dungeons, Nebula Island (Blessing Pouches and Conquest Chests)
[*] Material Transmutation rewards
[*] All Things Workshop: Added a variety of miscellaneous crafting recipes that exist on other crafting merchants to the All Things Workshop.
[*] Guilds: Added the option to teleport to zones currently controlled by the guild through the Guild UI.
[*] Map: Added the ability to share your map pins to others via chat link, by either selecting the link button on the pin or by Alt-Left Clicking the pin.
[*] Chat: Added a category for recently used stickers to make them more quickly accessible.
[*] Party Board: Added the ability to Favorite individual Party Board categories and view them through the shorter Favorites list.
[*] Codex: Players will no longer be stuck in an invisible state when exiting the instanced area during the One-Eyed Hawk Exploration Codex in Urstella Fields.
[*] Crimson Manor: Adjusted the event area of 'Best Way to Prevent the Worst' so it no longer overlaps with the waypoint.
[*] Grayclaw Forest: Wolf King Hill: Fixed a spot where players were blocked by unexpected collision.
[*] Localization: Updated tooltips on several abilities for clarity on how they function.
[*] Vanguards: Fixed an issue where the previous Vanguard leader would still be labeled as such after changing Vanguard leadership.
[*] PlayStation 5: Controllers will now vibrate again when playing on PlayStation 5.
[*] Controller: Cooking: Results are now immediately shown when using the search bar in the Cooking menu.
[*] Morphs: A Swim Morph will no longer be entered when using a Dash Morph in shallow water.
[*] HUD: Removed the red dot notification from the Upcoming Schedule widget.
[*] Party: Party invitations are now automatically declined upon changing instances.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the camera shake effect when being hit by broad area effect abilities.
[*] Staff: Fixed an issue causing the Mana Regen effect from Inner Peace to be lost upon receiving a CC effect while the Immune to CC Specialization was active.
[*] Crossbow: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be shown in various locations when the Wild Barrage Specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
[*] Wand: Ray of Disaster now deals damage to moving targets.
[*] Greatsword: Mastery: The Reckless Assault Mastery Node now grants the described effects.
[/list]
[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the VFX on the Dawnlight Crossbows weapon skin to be displayed in the incorrect position.
[*] Fixed an issue causing lightning VFX to not be shown on parts of the Stormcaller Shroud outfit.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the book to be held upside down when the Abyssal Wand weapon skin was equipped.
[*] The Adventurous Pioneer outfit can now be dyed.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.8.0
notes.notes:
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.8.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 30 and last up to 3 hours. Search for treasure in the Mystic Portal event, experience the new Trait Resonance feature, and show off your favorite looks with Illusion Workshop. There’s even an Ornate Coin Twitch Drop waiting to be claimed.

Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.

[h3]Mystic Portal: Treasure Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] From May 1 through May 15, daily login rewards will grant you special Mystic Keys. Open Mystic Portals to play a treasure-hunting minigame!
[*] Hunt down hidden treasure chests through different puzzles for a variety of rewards including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials!
[/list]
[h3]Trait Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipment that has fully developed Traits - all 3 unlocked and at max tier - can now take on a fourth trait through Trait Resonance.
[*] When you unlock Trait Resonance on an item, the fourth trait can be added randomly or specified at unlock through the use of Trait Resonance Stones. Trait Resonance can be re-rolled at any time after unlocking.
[*] Re-traiting one of the base three traits on an item will cause the Trait Resonance to become inactive, but not lost, until the base traits are at max tier once more.
[*] Trait Resonance Stones are acquired by obtaining fragments through Material Transmutation and crafting them along with ores into Trait Resonance Stones at any crafting merchant.
[*] New Lithograph Book entries have been added which grant Trait Resonance Stones as rewards.
[/list]
[h3]Illusion Workshop[/h3]
[list]
[*] Take character customization to even greater heights by customizing the appearance of individual gear pieces through the new Illusion Workshop!
[*] Use consumable Illusion Scrolls to capture the appearance of gear collected in the world and then transform it into a usable Illusion for your cosmetic collection.
[*] Illusion appearances can now be dyed, allowing for even more variety in what you wear.
[*] Apply these appearances to your currently worn equipment to customize your look! Additional illusions will be added to this system over time. At this time, only Epic gear items are available for Illusion Workshop.
[/list]
Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/illusion-workshop]official announcement[/url] for additional details.

[h3]Ornate Coin Twitch Drop[/h3]
Top up on Ornate Coins with the latest THRONE AND LIBERTY Twitch Drop. From activities that will help fast track progress to an open tournament with over one million in Lucent on the line, May is all about rewarding players through unique events. To kick off the festivities, the Ornate Coin Twitch Drop will be available following maintenance on May 1.

Whether you watch your favorite streamer or hang out with a few new Creators, simply tune in for 5 hours of cumulative watch time before May 14 to claim yours.
[list]
[*] 200 Ornate Coins (2 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Ornate Coins (5 total hours watched)
[/list]
If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform) you play on. Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trials: Party Matchmaking rewards for Dimensional Trials matchmaking are now acquired after opening the tier's treasure chest, and only acquired on the first tier after a group uses matchmaking to form.
[*] Arena: When a match ends with no deaths on either team, both teams will see a Loss result but team members will not lose ranking points or matchmaking reward counts.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Icons now display on the Party UI for each member of a party that shows which role they selected for matchmaking - tank, healer, or damage.
[*] Party Board: Added Abyss Dungeons and Nebula Island as categories to post Party Board recruitment notices.
[*] A shortcut to the respective Party Board section has been added to the Map Region List for each Abyss Dungeon.

[*] Items: Purchasing items with max purchase limits now works with partial remaining quantities when using the Purchase All button.
[*] Items: When filtering merchants for Limited quantity items, the display now also shows items in the list that you have already purchased max quantities of.
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where NPCs and objects occasionally need to be interacted with twice after leaving or joining an instance.
[*] Gameplay: The Map and Minimap are now hidden while inside various instanced locations that don't have map to be shown.
[*] Cooking: Honey Roasted Apple recipe text no longer appears in Korean.
[*] Gameplay: Codex: Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on the wrong side of the Inner Castle Gate as a Jumping Golem.
[*] Schedule: Fixed an issue where later events (such as Gigantrite spawns) would sometimes appear before other events on the schedule.
[*] Amitoi House: Additional cinematics are now available from the Memories of Adventure book in the Amitoi House.
[*] Shop: Server Transfer Tickets should now appear available on the Server Transfer page as soon as they've been purchased.
[*] Nebula Island: The weekly time cap (playable hours) for Nebula Island has increased to 10 hours per week. This is a hard time limit cap and cannot be exceeded.

[*] Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Added an effect that reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind Arrow by 30%. Increased damage by 50% against monsters.
[*] Deluzhnoa's Ancient Petrified Staff: Now Reduces the casting speed of Infernal Meteor by 50%. Changed Cooldown Speed 4% to Perception 4 on the item stats.
[*] Cordy's Grasp of Manipulation: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Giant Cordy's Blessing, so that it no longer refers to the wrong skill in the description.
[*] Daigon's Stormblade: After using the Whirlwind Shield skill, when the One-Strike Shield skill hits, there is an 80% chance to fire a Whirlwind Shield projectile that deals 135% of the base damage.
[*] Cloak of the Frozen Expanse: Crafting this item no longer results in receiving a Shaikal's Mindveil Spear.
[*] Forgotten Lotus Gloves now properly drop in Bercant Estate.
[*] Crimson Doomblade: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Kasier's Thirst, so that it no longer incorrectly states that it increases Witty Retort's healing.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon Mastery: Adjusted the text descriptions of multiple Weapon Mastery nodes to better clarify their effects.
[/list]
[h3]Crossbows[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Tactical Counterattack: Now has a 1-second casting time.
[/list]
[h3]Daggers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Movement Speed Focus: Fixed this Tactics Mastery so it no longer decreases Buff Duration by 14% instead of 1.4% at 8/10 points.
[/list]
[h3]Greatsword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guillotine Blade: The effect that reduces incoming healing effects is now subject to the target's Weaken resistance.
[/list]
[h3]Wand[/h3]

[*] Blessed Barrier: Duration increase specialization will no longer cause the duration to end prematurely.
[*] Celestial Boost: Fixed an issue where the tooltip was not updating with dynamic values.

[h3]Sword and Shield[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Shot at Victory: Annihilation Blade specialization: Reduced the required points from 10 to 7.
[*] Mastery: Blade Momentum: Fixed an issue where specific dynamic values in the description were not being retrieved correctly.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]

notes.notes:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/25PpSocJAeP2asPe2NunFT/2140350f255da4b6a08795b82fc4786a/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Dungeons_TempleofSilaves_A.png[/img]
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] update 2.4.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on April 2 and last approximately 3.5 hours. It includes a new system to manage your runes, adjustments to Guild and Riftstone Boss loot, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.

[h3]RUNE MANAGEMENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new Rune Book UI has been added to the Item section of the Main Menu.
[*] Instead of obtaining multiple copies of each rune as an item, obtaining runes now unlocks and levels up a single unified entry in the Rune Book UI - these unified basic Rune can be equipped to multiple items at once. Chaos Runes can only be equipped to one item at a time.
[*] Rune Synergies have been simplified by removing the various quality tiers and providing a single maximized Synergy benefit for each rune color combination.
[*] The Rune listings allow you to search, favorite, and filter through the list of your available Runes.
[*] When selecting an item to modify equipped runes, the rune list will only show runes that are eligible to equip to that item type.
[*] Drag and drop Runes from your collection list to the Item's unlocked Rune slots in the top section of the UI to equip Runes to an item.
[*] The rune list now displays the level, stat benefit, and stat value of each collected rune along with a progress bar that displays along the bottom of each Rune entry.
[*] This progress bar acts as a Rune leveling progress guarantee; now when you receive Runes of the same level as the one you have collected, this progress bar increases until it fills.
[*] Once filled, that rune will increase to the next level; setting a maximum amount of times, you can receive an individual rune of the same level before receiving a rune level increase.
[*] Chaos Runes: A maximum of 100 Chaos Runes can be stored in the Rune UI. Chaos Runes you don't intend to use can be deleted from the list, freeing up a slot.
[*] Rune Fragments will no longer be able to be acquired, and any existing rune fragments in your inventories or storage will eventually be removed!
[/list]
[h3]GUILD RAID AND RIFTSTONE BOSSES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the loot drop tables for Talandre Guild Raid and Riftstone bosses (Daigon, Leviathan, Pakilo Naru, Manticus Brothers) to include a guaranteed T2 Armor or Accessory drop on each kill in addition to the current drop pools.
[/list]
[h3]MATERIAL TRANSMUTATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Material Transmutation: Implemented options to auto-add designated material types and grades to your Material Transmutation progress.
[*] Material Transmutation: Added the ability to split stacks of items with Shift-Left Click when adding items to Material Transmutation.
[*] Material Transmutation: Bulk-adding materials now selects up to 300 eligible items, increased from the previous cap of 20 at a time.
[/list]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trial: Fixed an issue preventing groups from posting Party Board recruitment above Tier 1 for Dimensional Trials.
[*] Added the option to copy skill and specialization presets to a new preset for editing as an alternative to creating skill presets from a blank state.
[*] Skill presets can now also be pasted as a chat link that allows others to copy the preset skill and specialization contents.
[*] Replaced Rare Rune chests with Epic Rune chests for the following reward types: Dimensional Trials, Weekly Missions, Arena Coin shop, Abyss dungeons, World Bosses, Guild Raids, and Material Transmutation. Items: Removed Epic Tier 2 and Tier 1 equipment drops from basic zone population mobs.
[*] Adjusted the crafting menu for items like Skill Books to enable you to combine component ingredients that have multiple substitutes into a single craft.
[*] Herba Village: Added Arena Sundries Merchant to the available town NPCs.
[*] Guilds: Tax Deliver, Siege, and Interserver Riftstone and Boonstone award distribution can now be distributed unevenly when distributing to all members, not just participants.
[*] Gate of Infinity, Taedal's Tower: Added the ability to move to other floors without exiting the dungeon.
[*] Targeting: Added an option to target nameplate settings to prevent nameplate transparency being applied to targets who are actively attacking you.
[*] Siege: Small adjustments to the defense area boundaries to teleport out non-defenders from walls at the start of a Siege.
[*] Arena: Fixed a situation where some food buffs that should be removed on Arena entry were not being removed properly.
[*] Nebula Island: Removed some ceiling clutter from the boss arena that interfered with viewing angles.
[*] Nebula Island: Fixed an issue where Grimturg's attack pattern could behave unexpectedly when its aggro target was at a distance.
[*] Guild Raid: Fixed boss reset behavior for Pakilo Naru.
[*] Character: Wind indicators on your character are now hidden during cutscenes and interaction camera views.
[/list]
[h3]HALL OF ILLUSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added checkpoints to Hall of Illusion levels to allow players to take breaks between fights.
[*] Molgras: Fixed an issue where Molgras could occasionally teleport outside of the attackable area.
[*] Molgras: Festive Trees now respawn 10 seconds after Molgras returns to the center of the arena.
[*] Hall of Illusion: Lionhead: Fixed an issue that could cause the Zone of Pain effect to apply even though your interaction was interrupted.
[/list]
[h3]WAR GAMES[/h3]
[list]
[*] War Games: Added a display of which weapons members of the team are currently using to better inform team-making strategy.
[*] War Games: Can now edit the display name of War Game Lobbies.
[*] War Games: Minor adjustment to the color displayed for Yellow Team to avoid overlap with the yellow used for Friendly guilds.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chained damage or healing now displays as an increasing floating damage number that sums up the total damage or healing done rather than separate numbers for each hit.
[*] HUD: Added setting to enable/disable Item Acquisition popup messages.
[*] Weapon Specialization: Added shortcuts to open material containers in your storage for material costs needed to unlock Weapon Specialization nodes.
[*] Adjusted the Hall of Illusion reward popup to clarify the rewards can only be claimed once.
[*] Guild Menu: Adjusted display of Friendly guilds in the Guild info UI.
[*] Added HUD shortcuts for Amitoi House and Fishing mode that can be arranged within the UI.
[*] Currency display: Removed outdated event coins that had zero-quantities from token lists in the UI.
[*] Items: Minor adjustments to the display of Lithograph information when viewing item tooltip details.
[*] Controller: Made multiple adjustments to UI windows for controller focus areas and window priority.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.1.0
notes.notes:
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.1.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on March 12 and last approximately 7.5 hours. It includes Nebula Island, Artifacts, new solo dungeon bosses, and new 3-Star Dungeons. Find the full list of changes listed below, plus a guide on our new features from [url=https://www.youtube.com/@grobsXO]GrobsXO[/url].

[h3]New Activity: Nebula Island[/h3]
“For me, one of the biggest highlights of Talandre is Nebula Island and the Artifact System,” GrobsXO said. ”If you’re into PvP and love tweaking your character’s build, you're going to love these updates.”

[previewyoutube=1d6Sd6t4K0M;full][/previewyoutube]
Nebula Island is a new interserver activity accessible to level 55 players through the Secret Dungeons' Lawless Wilds tab. Players can spend up to 5 hours per week there, with additional time available through Nebula Charge Stones.

The island consists of a central village and six distinct regions, including one peaceful zone and four war zones where PvP is always enabled. Players can access various hunting grounds through portals in the central village and collect Lesser and Greater Nebula Stones to exchange for items. The island features hourly events and periodic field boss battles with limited participation capacity. A new exclusive accessory system called Artifacts has also been introduced specifically for Nebula Island content.

[h3]New System: Artifacts[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6OBOGZ15oVLqS29n2yS6dl/a24196adb13a370110c9d5ae9dceee7b/Artifact-1920.jpg[/img]

Redefine your playstyle through unique skills with Artifact item sets. Artifacts can be obtained from Nebula island and Abyss Dungeons in Talandre.

The system consists of six parts: four Talistones, a Solarstone, and a Lunarstone, each with unique stats and effects. There are 14 different Artifact sets across three grades (2 Common, 4 Uncommon, and 8 Rare), with some stats being randomly determined upon acquisition. Players can trigger set bonuses by equipping 2, 4, or 6 matching pieces from the same set. The Solarstone provides an Active Skill while the Lunarstone grants a Passive Skill when equipped.

[h3]New Solo Dungeon Bosses[/h3]

[previewyoutube=gL7hvLDJicU;full][/previewyoutube]
Conquer new solo dungeon bosses like Umbrakan and Lionhead for unique rewards on your way to the throne.

[b]Umbrakan[/b]

The ferocity of a beast, the intelligence of a human, and the vitality of a great tree. This grotesque being hid in the forest to eat small animals and insects for nutrients. However, after absorbing the mana from a human wizard, it began hunting humans. Now it casts illusions to slaughter intruders.

[b]Lionhead[/b]

The Arkeum subjected Demian, a child born between a demon and a human, to intense training, including mana infusions from the Abyssal Meteor. Demian achieved remarkable feats on the battlefield. However, upon seeing blood he caused excessive slaughter. His steel lion helmet became a symbol of death and terror.

[h2]New 3-Star Dungeons[/h2]
[h3]Doomrot Grove[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1yjNHWGyQzzTgUZOgHQ2s2/37b39849ea0a3c5127cf01f0a30dd114/Screenshot_HighRes_20250124_164530_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Norn Bercant was kidnapped by the Crimson family and turned into a ferocious, mutated creature. With a power as immense as her deep grudge, she created Doomrot Grove, a secluded garden cut off from the outside world.

[h3]Twisted Laboratory[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7JJqgVZcEE8D9JPcc2FQ6G/e41e419450fe5b122a75d0d827485c89/Screenshot_HighRes_20250124_160322_1920.jpg[/img]

Bioweapons leaked out of the Crimson family’s lab and killed most people in the manor. The mystery of Kaiser Crimson’s survival remains. Those who discovered the truth have taken it to their grave.

[h3]Vanguards - Multi-Party (Raid) System[/h3]
We now support raids (multi-party groups) of up to 8 parties and 48 players.
[list]
[*] Vanguards can be created through the Party Management window.
[*] The player who first forms the raid becomes the initial Vanguard Leader, and can transfer the role later.
[*] Vanguard Leaders can adjust party composition or remove members from the vanguard.
[*] Vanguard Leaders may also set join conditions such as 'Guild Members Only','Allied Guilds Only', or open-entry.
[*] Various content can be completed while in Vanguards with some exceptions.
[*] You cannot join party-based instances such as Dungeons or Dimensional Trials while in a vanguard.
[*] Field Boss instances are also unavailable for entry as a vanguard.
[*] If a player enters a Dominion event they will be removed from the vanguard.
[*] Entering Siege or Tax Delivery events as a vanguard will remove all members not in the Vanguard Leader's guild from the parties.
[/list]
[h3]Nameplate Targeting Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New targeting features have been added to Settings > Gameplay > Character > Large Scale Combat Mode.
[*] When Large Scale Combat Mode is activated, an effect is added that emphasizes the target's nameplate more.
[*] Additional options are available in this new setting menu to customize your targeting experience:
[*] Character nameplate transparency
[*] Non-target character nameplate transparency
[*] Target color adjustments
[*] An additional new option has been added to Settings > Gameplay > UI > HUD to adjust the size of the vertical target indicator line that appears on the nameplate of targeted characters.
[/list]
[h3]Dimensional Trial Season 1 Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ranking rewards from Dimensional Trial Season 1 will be distributed after this maintenance, to characters who had eligible scores prior to Server Consolidation. Check your mail to receive these!
[/list]
[h3]Field Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Talandre field bosses will have their health nerfed by 30% to account for those struggling to kill them in guild vs guild and dominion events. This is a temporary measure and a permanent feature will arrive in a future update.
[*] Reduced wait time at the start of Field Bosses: Party formation portals will continue to remain open for 5 minutes, while the Boss preparation time after parties have entered the instance has been reduced to 1 minute, down from 5 minutes.
[*] Field Boss: Daigon: The boss will now reset properly when the last player dies during his leap phase.
[*] Field Boss: Fixed an issue that caused allied players to appear as targetable during Dominion or Peace Field Boss events.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle Pass: Fixed an issue where the "Craft 3 Uncommon or higher equipment items" mission would not complete after 3 successful crafts.
[*] Battle Pass: Abundance Fruit and Weapon Mastery Book items now have a 30 minute effect duration when consumed.
[*] Unfortunately, Golem shapeshifts acquired while on the quest 'When the Day Comes' will now have to remain in the quest area and may not go on adventures to boss fights or other world locations.
[*] PvP: Adjusted the Fonsine's Blessing timers for respawn locations used during Siege and Tax Delivery.
[*] Cooking: Fixed several instances of incorrect utility buff icons on craftable food items.
[*] The opening Talandre cutscene now only plays automatically once when entering the game after the Talandre update.
[*] Black Anvil Forge: Fixed an issue that caused team colors to not display when re-entering the Dominion event in Black Anvil Forge.
[*] Console: Fixed several issues related to automatic party matchmaking for Dominion bosses on consoles.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused healing reduction effects between Meteor and Focused Fire Bombs to stack to excessive values.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the following combat abilities from firing successfully when using the auto-move to target settings. Affected abilities:
[*] Greatsword: Devastating Smash, Guillotine Blade
[*] Dagger: Inject Venom (Secondary Ability), Frenzied Sword Dance
[*] Spear: Death From Above
[*] Bow: Zephyr's Knock, Ensnaring Arrow, Strafing, Deadly Marker
[*] Crossbows: Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Weak Point Shot
[*] Wand: Cursed Nightmare, Time for Punishment, Ray of Disaster
[/list]
[h3]Hall of Illusion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to continue to spawn after the completion painting appeared.
[*] Adjusted a water height that caused players to drop out of swim morph in the Waterways section of Hall of Illusion.
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple mismatches between English voiceover and in-game subtitles in the Talandre Adventure Codex. Additional subtitle polishing will continue to address remaining mismatch issues in future updates.
[*] Updated Weapon Mastery description tooltips across multiple skills to better reflect their functional behavior.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party Window: Fixed the display of the controller version of the party menu that showed all members with the Party Leader icon.
[*] Field Bosses: Updated text to fix Korean strings being displayed on Field Boss reward UI.
[*] Ring Menu: No longer displays unacquired Emotes or Morphs when customizing the ring menu.
[*] Characters below level 55 should no longer be able to access the Hall of Illusion UI when using a controller.
[*] Players will no longer be blocked from leaving the Lithograph menu when using a controller.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

Holiday cheer spreads across Solisium as the Startree Solstice event begins. How will your guild celebrate the most wonderful time of the year? 

Check out the full release notes, including event details, new Cooking adjustments, additional Arch Boss spawn scheduling, and more, below. 

[h2]Startree Solstice Event[/h2]
The Startree Solstice event will spread holiday cheer across Solisium from December 12 through January 9, 2025. Join event-only Snowdrift Island arena matches for event-specific rewards, explore festive villages with holiday decorations (including Trees of Gratitude), gather themed cosmetics like the Jolly Arsenal weapons via the Event Pass, and more. Even Gigantrite and your Amitoi will participate.

Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/news/articles/startree-solstice-event]official announcement[/url] for full details, including the rewards and activities you can experience in the Startree Solstice. 

[h2]Arch Bosses - Additional Spawns for Bellandir and Tevent[/h2]
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve the recent issues related to Arch Boss encounters. 

We understand the frustration this caused to many, and to ensure players are able to attempt those encounters again, we will be running a limited duration event from December 12, 2024 through January 9, 2025. 

During this event, Arch Bosses will spawn twice on their normally scheduled days, once in peace and once in conflict. The additional spawn will take place at 6:00 p.m./18:00 server time and the current 8:00 p.m./20:00 time will also spawn as normal. Good luck, adventurers!

[h2]Lifestyle Content - Cooking[/h2]
[list][*] New Cooking contracts can be obtained through Contract Managers. 
[*] The number of unique cooked food items has been reduced by the consolidation of food quality levels.
[*] General dishes are now crafted as Uncommon grade, Banquet and dungeon ingredient food as Rare grade, and elixirs come in Rare or Uncommon grade depending on the materials used.
[*] The quality of materials used when cooking now determines the quantity of meals received.
[*] Rare materials consume 1 ingredient and produce 3 completed meals.
[*] Uncommon materials consume 3 ingredients and produce 2 completed meals.
[*] Common materials consume 5 ingredients and produce 1 completed meal.
[*] Ingredients for Banquets have been adjusted to account for the new grade consolidation and numbers of meals produced through Cooking.
[*] Ingredient gathering and drop rates have been adjusted due to the change in quantities consumed and number of meals produced through Cooking.
[*] Previously obtained high-tier ingredients intended for use in Banquets can be exchanged for updated rare ingredients through the Dissolve system.
[*] All recipes may now be crafted at both Cooking Ovens and Campfires.[/list]
[h2]Dungeon Matchmaking Penalty[/h2]
[list][*] A cooldown time is now applied for characters who cancel dungeon matchmaking after a party is matched or after entering a dungeon through matchmaking. 
[*] This cooldown prevents you from queueing for another dungeon immediately. The timer starts at 10 minutes and will increase with subsequent additional cancellations.
[*] Re-entering an already completed dungeon using Party Matchmaking while the previous instance is still available results in a matchmaking penalty being applied upon leaving the instance. If re-entering the same dungeon using Party Matchmaking, make sure the previous instance has been cleared before doing so. [/list]

[list]
[*] Field and Arch Bosses: Increased the drop rates of Rare and Epic gear from these encounters. 
[*] PvP: Reduced the duration of respawn protection granted after entering Conflict areas via resurrecting at a Guild Resurrection Stone or arriving through a Guild Summoning Circle. 
[*] Automatic logout time for AFK characters has been increased to 3 hours.
[*] Arena: Weekly reset for the Arena has been adjusted to match the weekly maintenance time, similar to other weekly reset content.
[*] Arena: Upgraded Purification Stones are now usable while in Arenas.
[*] Arena: Added runes to the Arena Vendor that can be purchased with Arena Coins. 
[*] Weekly Missions: Adjusted the amount of Dimensional Trials needed to complete the weekly mission.
[*] Gigantrite: Adjusted the route Gigantrite takes between Stonegard and Saurodoma Island.
[*] Fishing: New Fishing Hotspots may appear in bodies of water around the world, indicated by a circling fish effect. The wise fisher knows to cast their line into these areas whenever they’re spotted!
[*] Fishing: Expanded the Fishing Codex to include new fish and a new reward tier.
[*] War Games: Added team chat channel for use during matches.
[*] War Games: Player icons will now display on the minimap.
[*] War Games: Fixed an issue causing the team outfit to remain visible after exiting a match.
[*] War Games: Fixed an issue preventing the Stats button from bringing up game results after ending a match.
[*] Options: Added option to automatically reject party invitations that come from all players not on your Friends list.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Completing dungeons by queuing for random matchmaking now awards 4 Soul Shard Selection Boxes instead of Soul Shards specific to the matched dungeon.[/list]
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list][*] Stats: Fortitude: Fixed an issue that could cause stat effects to not increase when improving your Fortitude stat value.
[*] Skill: Shadow Strike: The teleportation effect of Shadow Strike now works while the player is jumping.
[*] Skill: Mana Exchange: Remove CC Specialization: Fixed an issue causing this skill specialization to not take effect.
[*] Butcher's Canyon, Valley of Slaughter: The coordinated crowd control across multiple targets required to complete this dungeon has been adjusted. Now crowd control effects can be applied to the target enemies individually, and once it has been affected, the targeted enemy will not go back to an invulnerable state.[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list][*] Auction House: Removed the confirmation button when the total amount of Lucent earned from sales is below 10 Lucent.
[*] Ping Display: The option to display your current ping on the HUD should now actually be available in the Settings menu.
[*] Amitoi Expedition: Zone levels now display on unlocked expedition zones.
[*] Amitoi Expedition: Expedition menu now saves selected Amitoi lineup and expedition duration, even when cancelling or exiting the UI.
[*] Party Frames: Improved targeted player visuals on the party frame as well as providing an indicator on the frame when hovering over the target with your cursor.

notes.notes:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/nwRAdv2S3U0Azfl8RNPEd/eb4069dafd9378e7dc03f44ecf07c3b3/TL_Halloween_14_1920x740.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.6.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on November 6 and last approximately 2 hours. It includes stability and back-end service improvements. Check out our Haunted Harvest community showcase, plus a preview of what to expect in the first Tax Delivery and Castle Siege events. We’ve also compiled some of your most impressive achievements since launch.

[h2]Haunted Harvest Community Showcase[/h2]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7fVuQRswJ7uvNNqnd5zZnf/d2be7d3c1bc04ba595aa302aa39bc0aa/Haunted-Harvest-Community-Showcase-1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Thanks to everyone that participated in our Haunted Harvest Community Showcase. Look forward to future showcases and contests on the THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord.

The THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord server was built for Amazon Games staff members to host events, townhalls, AMAs, and talk to the community. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make Solisium better for every type of player. Guilds are another major aspect of Discord engagement.

To find the right group, first ask yourself what type of guild would you enjoy the most. Want to focus on specific game modes? There’s a guild for that. How about leaderboards? There’s a guild for that too. Now think about what you’re most excited about in THRONE AND LIBERTY. There’s a guild for that, if you want to create it. Gather players with shared interests, goals, or something else entirely for an even more satisfying experience.

[h3]First Month in Solisium[/h3]
We’re happy to share some notable stats since the start of your journey and can’t wait to see what you’ll accomplish next.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4XRcn23ssGQOCeCKMICpQg/b5ea2c5475a120c1ecc77ffebccafbe2/EN_-_TL-First-Month-Info-1920.jpg[/img]
[h3]Tax Delivery Event[/h3]
Now that all First Defenders have been selected, the reigning guild may schedule the Tax Delivery event for their server.
[list]
[*] Reigning guilds may schedule a Tax Delivery between 2PM and 1 AM local server time.
[*] To check when the Tax Delivery event is scheduled, open up your Map and then check the Timetable under Daily.
[/list]
Tax Delivery is a major guild event where the reigning guild must protect a caravan of taxes acquired from their territory. If the reigning guild successfully transport their spoils from Vienta Village to Stoneguard Castle, they’ll receive a generous bounty of Lucent and Sollant. However, if an attacking player thwarts the delivery, the rewards will instead be distributed to every participant outside of the First Defenders’ Alliance.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/xs9Pj5kkNpScuop1o5EcS/f4e7812c32c5bddac24a86a30bc938c4/TL_Closed_Beta_Screenshots_TaxDelivery_v01_1080.jpeg[/img]
Each Tax Delivery begins with the reigning guild selecting a member to become the Tax Delivery Golem. Capitalize on powerful abilities as the Titan Cargo to fend off the seemingly endless onslaught of players that will stop at nothing for a piece of the prize. Communication and coordination between the reigning guild can make or break a delivery.

Attacking guilds must destroy the Titan Cargo Sealing Stone. Fortunately, they have the ability to contend with the might of the Titan Cargo through barriers, bomb carriers, Archeum Knights, and the fearsome debuffs of the Chaos Golem.

How will you prepare to stop, or secure, the Tax Delivery?

[h3]Castle Siege Event[/h3]
The first Castle Siege event will commence on November 17.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4kBQ6VnPu8cJ6hosvSN9LU/41f461b7786ca6b690924b37b33b934b/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Combat_Siege_A_1920.jpg[/img]
As the siege begins, guilds have 45 minutes to achieve victory. Attackers must storm the castle, breach its fortified gates, and capture the throne room. Defenders, transported inside the castle at the start, must hold their ground, leveraging every resource at their disposal to repel the invaders. If the throne is contested when the timer runs out, the siege enters a tense 3-minute overtime, where the battle's outcome hangs in the balance.

Strategic locations like Siege Ruins play a crucial role. Capturing these ruins not only provides teleportation and resurrection points, but also allows attacking guilds to summon powerful Siege Golems. Each golem — whether it’s the Stone Crasher, Battle Carrier, Gate Hammer, or Jump Attacker — brings unique abilities to the battlefield, from devastating castle walls to transporting players over them.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1ox2hj8681BPtd5zF9emld/710ccf4536601d0501358b3c7f62a8da/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
Attackers must navigate the castle's intricate layout, using environmental elements like the sewage system for surprise ambushes or operating gate levers to control access points. The Pillage Stones and Resurrection Stones scattered throughout the battlefield add another layer of strategy, offering opportunities to steal resources or reinforce their position. While most guilds will focus on taking power in the throne room, these 5 Pillage Stones can be captured by any attackers to snatch Sollant and Lucent from the Castle Vault, even if the reigning guild maintains control.

No matter your strategy, all tactics will converge at the throne. There can only be one champion of Stoneguard Castle. Form alliances to rule together or betray your way to the top.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3rGJhYTb9YZvM5j3CdxnnL/dd44d824bc1b2f42dd86474d88c8ad7d/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
We look forward to watching server storylines develop across these events. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.3.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 16 and last approximately 6 hours. Team up with other players to conquer random dungeons through a new matchmaking option. This update also includes bug fixes for localization, UI, and more to help make your next adventure in Solisium an even smoother experience. Check out the full release notes broken down by platform below.

[/i]
[h2]All Platforms[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character deletion wait time is now set to 24 hours after initiating deletion of a character.
[*] Server transfer cooldowns are now displayed on the Server Transfer window.
[*] Server Transfer cooldown time has been increased to 30 days between transfers, and the Server Transfer free ticket promotion has ended.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dynamic Events: Improved rewards for all Dynamic Event modes to better match the effort made by players during the event.
[*] Guilds: Hunt-type Guild Contracts ("Defeat Various Monsters") can now only be initiated once per day. If completion carries over into a new day, a new contract will become immediately available.
[*] Guilds: When Leaders leave a guild, leadership reassignment now checks in order of: highest available guild rank, highest available guild contribution, longest guild membership time.
[*] Quests: The Terrific Trio of Carmine Forest: Corrected the map indicators for the quest area.
[*] Arena: Players can no longer re-join completed Arena matches.
[*] Crafting: Adjusted the crafting materials for Rare Blank Lithograph recipes. These no longer differentiate between Epic and Precious Enchanted Ink, and simply use 'Enchanted Ink' as a material (renamed Precious Enchanted Ink).
[*] Fishing: Improved the 'hook' animation while fishing.
[*] Customization: Adjusted some character customization options to keep eyes safely behind eyelids.
[*] Tutorial: Fixed an issue where players could become blocked by logging out during the morph portion of the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Dungeons[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new matchmaking option will allow players to join a randomized dungeon from all available options and more easily fill groups. Players could previously only queue for specific dungeons.
[*] Increased the bonus HP and Damage buff applied when matchmaking dungeon groups from 5% to 10%.
[*] Adjusted matchmaking logic to attempt to form groups of similar power progression more consistently.
[*] Party members can no longer be kicked from the party during active boss encounters.
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected a tooltip text error for the Crossbow's Quick Fire: 'Damage Increase' skill specialization.
[*] Corrected a tooltip error for the Staff passive ability 'Mana Amp' that incorrectly switched the HP and Mana values.
[*] 'Precious Skill Growth' books now properly indicate whether they upgrade Active or Passive skills.
[*] Corrected a tooltip error for the Wand's Corrupted Magic Circle: 'Decaying Touch' skill specialization that claimed the skill applied to multiple targets when it does not.
[*] Applied latest localization updates, including the correction of several untranslated strings.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guild Contracts: Time to Next Contract now displays more reliably after completing guild contracts.
[*] Amitoi, Morph Menus: Selecting the 'Only View Favorites' option no longer cuts off the bottom of the UI in some instances.
[*] Party Board: Various bug fixes related to awkward or incorrect behavior of the Party Board display.
[*] Party Board: Join requests now show the character's weapon types and guild information.
[*] Manage Party Display: Various bug fixes related to the behavior of the Manage Party / Group Member UI.
[*] Arena: Completing weekly missions now displays a notification, and the Arena UI will display the time until the next weekly mission refresh.
[*] Relocated the Help button to the top right corner across multiple UI windows.
[*] Moderation warnings no longer appear on each login once acknowledged.
[*] Added details to some connectivity-related error messages.
[*] Added a button to check name availability when creating or changing character names.
[/list]
[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some areas of the Amitoi and Morph menus that could not be navigated with the D-pad.
[*] Fishing will no longer be cancelled by pressing the B key while in fishing mode.
[*] Fixed a case where charged abilities could still fire after cancelling a long button press.
[/list]
[h2]PC[/h2]
[list]
[*] Temporarily disabled the ability to attach file uploads in character customization or support requests while we improve the file attachment functionality.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Team Update: Launch Timing
notes.notes:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/74sWYqJEsrBLK1TRpiKLTA/94d0047f105a2baaa4a4e3ce7386d478/TL_Technical_Test_Screenshots_World_Vinyard_v01-1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
We want to thank all the players who began their journey in Solisium during our Open Beta test. Your participation and feedback have been invaluable as we closely collaborate with NCSOFT to drive changes that reimagine THRONE AND LIBERTY from its original launch in Korea to our launch in Amazon Games' supported regions. Additionally, we’ve seen a surge of excitement from players surrounding the latest major patch in Korea, which introduced a variety of updates and systems. We are committed to delivering the best possible player experience at launch, and as a direct result of player feedback, testing efforts, and the reception to new features, we will be making key changes to the game.

Our team began work after the Open Beta, but fully implementing community feedback and integrating new systems will take additional time. To give our team the time needed to incorporate the most critical pieces of feedback and systems, we have decided to move the THRONE AND LIBERTY launch to October 1, 2024, with Early Access starting on September 26, 2024. Below you dive into the specifics of the updates we’re implementing to ensure THRONE AND LIBERTY provides the best player experience possible at launch.

[h2]Launch Game Updates[/h2]
[h3]Updates Based on Player Feedback[/h3]

[b]Combat[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5ot5nmtFkVMaE0HqeH2VSD/20b39418f50d59e2300a2e9f1f6395c2/tl_announce_screenshots_combat_siege_f_1920.jpg[/img]
We will be working on combat updates that improve the early game combat experience for players, bringing it more in-line with the strong positive sentiment we received around the late to endgame combat. The improvements include:
[list]
[*] Improved camera controls to remove smoothing (an optional setting) and increase camera movement speed.
[*] Adjusting the skill acquisition timing to give players access to varied abilities and builds earlier in the leveling journey.
[*] Improving the intuitiveness of tab-targeting.
[/list]

[b]Leveling / Progression[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/iLsoqyMbWNzzgvRl3fCyE/6f51d66a61264832a6c2f05d2d168e90/TL_Closed_Beta_Screenshots_Combat_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
We heard feedback from Open Beta participants that they felt overwhelmed by the amount of systems that they were quickly introduced to in the early stages of their journey when leveling and progressing. We’re adjusting the progression journey to better spread out the introduction of systems, allowing players to focus on their early questing experience and learning the ins-and-outs of their character and combat before diving into too many additional systems.


[b]Guilds[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3kZ5fTrHL21s1Un8Yg6mPr/7275dc8c783fcb3e3ecdf581b0230a8f/TL_Summer_Game_Fest_Press_Screenshots_Combat_v01_B_1920.jpg[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY is better together. As a guild you can get more out of unique modes like Castle Siege, more confidently traverse the open world thanks to meaningful guild rewards, and better contend with hostile players. We’re expanding the tagging available to guilds so that players can more easily find guilds that align with their playstyles.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
We’re excited to announce that we will bring forward some key changes from the existing Korean version of THRONE AND LIBERTY. The three systems listed below aren’t a comprehensive look at every change we’re including, but these updates are a few we know engaged fans are eagerly anticipating. There will be additional Quality of Life (QoL) and other changes included alongside these new systems, and even more will be added post-launch.


[b]Skill Specializations[/b]

New skill specialization system will be implemented for launch in the regions supported by Amazon Games, allowing you to further customize your combat experience. Find a showcase of the new skill specializations below.

[previewyoutube=-syPRMktNcA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Lifeskills[/b]

Fishing and Cooking will be included for you to experience new lifeskill systems in THRONE AND LIBERTY. Cooking will include new recipes divided into attack, defense, life, and utility effects, while Fishing will introduce a new minigame allowing you to catch a variety of fish in the waters of Solisium.

[b]Cooking Showcase[/b]
[previewyoutube=gLumFsLDI5Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Fishing Showcase[/b]
[previewyoutube=VsT_zoAPcac;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Amitoi Expeditions[/b]

Amitoi Expeditions will be added, a new system allowing you to send your Amitois on adventures to collect rewards for you when they’re not accompanying you on your adventures in Solisium. It also includes the Amitoi House, your base of operations for Amitoi Expeditions.
[previewyoutube=K6lj3zojIYE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Looking Forward[/h2]
There are even more changes and updates that will arrive in THRONE AND LIBERTY in the future, and closer to launch we’ll have a team update that discusses the first two months of our roadmap and when you can expect certain content to release.

Once again, our team would like to thank you for your passion, participation, and support as we head toward releasing THRONE AND LIBERTY on October 1, 2024. We can’t wait to welcome you into Solisium.
